integrity.computation: Exact integer subset enumeration and Walsh transform checked for arm counts 1 through 8; infinite result follows from a direct signed factorization and arithmetic proof, not finite extrapolation.

scientific_limitations: Only connected vertex subsets of balanced spiders with exactly two edges per arm, with m>=2. The sharp positive multiplier gap is stated at singular arm counts; no arbitrary-tree or general nonresonant gap theorem is claimed. Historical novelty is bounded by inspected accessible literature, with residual risk of an unindexed equivalent. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Sparse exponential Fourier resonances for connected subtrees of subdivided stars
